title: Twitter Bikes Cyclone 3rd ET current product page and specification recheck
notes: Live check of the exact Cyclone 3rd ET manufacturer page. The listed build specifies WheelTop EDS TX wireless 2x12; SENICX PRF 34/50 crank; Sunshine 11-34 cassette; SUMC chain; WheelTop hydraulic disc brakes; RS AL7005 W21xH38 mm wheels; and RS 700x28C tires. The overview and spec table list a 420x90 mm high-modulus-carbon integrated cockpit for the displayed/default build, but a later 'Every build shares' section says alloy integrated bar/stem, 400x90 mm. No option mapping resolves this conflict, so do not generalize either cockpit statement. The page identifies a high-modulus-carbon frame and full-carbon fork and lists 9.2 kg net weight; size, pedals, accessories and weighing protocol are not stated. The manufacturer may change specifications.
